ImageDescription.value: A dish of Panackelty served in the village of Trimingham Norfolk, England. Panackelty (also spelt pan haggerty, panacalty, panaculty, panackerty, panaggie or panack) dish traditional throughout the northeast of England, especially associated with County Durham and in particular Sunderland. It consists of meat, mainly bacon or beef, and root vegetables, mainly potatoes, onions and carrots, all left to bake slowly in a high sided pan on low heat, or cooked slowly on a low heat in an oven.

Dr. Prosper De Pietra Santa,
